title: Oven-Roasted Smoky Korean Rice Cake Songpyeon
description: Smoky and snappy, these oven roasted rice cakes burst with Korean flavors and a hint of mirin, perfect for a low calorie crowd pleaser.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together mirin, soy sauce, gochugaru, and gochujang until smooth.
Toss the rice cake pieces in the sauce mixture until evenly coated.
Spread the coated rice cakes in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast for 12 minutes, then flip the cakes and drizzle with sesame oil.
Return to the oven for 8 more minutes until the edges are caramelized and the cakes are firm.
While the cakes finish roasting, gently heat the tofu cubes in a non‑stick pan until lightly browned.
Remove the rice cakes from the oven and top them with the browned tofu and sliced scallions.
Serve warm, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
